security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local photo editing with your Lightroom XMP presets
bundle.longDescription: darkroom edits your photos on your own computer with the Lightroom .xmp presets you bought: pick a preset, set its strength, fine-tune sliders, preview live, export. Rendering runs locally on the GPU; nothing is uploaded.
